shellCommands.command: ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/ | grep -i unreleased 2>/dev/null; cat /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json | grep version
cd /workspace && (npx next start -p 3939 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 5 && curl -s http://localhost:3939/ -o /tmp/page1.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"

ACTION_ID=$(grep -oE 'ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+' /tmp/page1.html | head -1); echo "ACTION_ID=$ACTION_ID"; time curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3939/" -H "Next-Action: $ACTION_ID" -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" --data "1=$ACTION_ID" -o /tmp/sync_resp.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} time %{time_total}s\n"; head -c 500 /tmp/sync_resp.html

ACTION_ID="0009cadb5b36e661def3a66c3a812944b1a960bf5d"; time curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3939/?_rsc=1" -H "Next-Action: $ACTION_ID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -o /tmp/sync_resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code} time %{time_total}s\n"; head -c 800 /tmp/sync_resp.txt

ACTION_ID="0009cadb5b36e661def3a66c3a812944b1a960bf5d"; curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3939/" -H "Next-Action: $ACTION_ID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -o /tmp/sync_resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code} time %{time_total}s\n"; head -c 800 /tmp/sync_resp.txt; echo; echo "---LOG---"; tail -30 /tmp/next.log

curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3939/" -H "Next-Action: 0009cadb5b36e661def3a66c3a812944b1a960bf5d" -H "Accept: text/x-component" --data-raw '[]' -o /tmp/sync_resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code} time %{time_total}s\n"; head -c 800 /tmp/sync_resp.txt; echo

curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3939/" -F "1=\$ACTION_ID_0009cadb5b36e661def3a66c3a812944b1a960bf5d" -o /tmp/sync_resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code} time %{time_total}s\n"; head -c 400 /tmp/sync_resp.txt; echo; echo "---LOG---"; tail -15 /tmp/next.log
